entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of scenario 'Challenge - Undying Vengeance' for female
identity:
You died in the Cataclysm.  Perhaps during the Cataclysm itself, perhaps in the riots leading up to it.  Someone killed you and hastily dumped you in a shallow grave, and that should have been the end.

But it wasn't.  Your rage at your own death, your thirst for vengeance, the sheer unfairness of it all, dragged you out of the grave and propelled you onward.  You can feel your murderer, out there in the world, and will stop at nothing until you've tracked them down.  You don't need to eat, sleep, or breathe anymore.  All you need is revenge.

<color_red>Scenario may take some time to load after game is entered</color>.

entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of scenario 'Challenge - The Fog' for female
identity: The Cataclysm was bad enough, but ever since then the weather has been…wrong.  An endless fog, interrupted only by the occasional remnant portal storm, shrouding the world in an obscuring blanket.  You managed to live through the Cataclysm, somehow, but you're not sure how you'll survive this.

entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of scenario 'One Last Dance on the Ice' for female
identity:
You've chased your quarry from the tragedies they left behind in the core of civilized space; all the way out here to the fringes of inhabited space.  You caught up with their ship here in the Salus system, and heavily damaged it, but the combat didn't leave your ship unscathed.  Opportunistic scavengers or pirates you don't know which, ambushed you as you were harrying your mark's ship and forcing it to ground.  You know they'll have crash landed somewhere on this planet but your ship, Truth and Reconciliation will never fly again.

You won't even walk away from this icy wreck if you can't destroy the squad of drones and scavenger bots that have dropped in to finish you off.

entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of scenario 'Path of the Wise' for female
identity: You demonstrated a connection with the unseen world from a young age, and a passing member of the Wise take an interest in you when they visited your people.  They took you with them to train as an apprentice, initiating you into the mysteries, and you studied with an eager mind.  Now you'll need to find your own way.
